headline: Committee sends claims proposal on without recommendation, defers vacancy item

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.summary: Members voted 9–0 to pass the claims proposal along with no recommendation, and the council vacancy proposal was deferred without objection. A committee report goes to the full council, most likely on July 7th.
meeting.recap: Members voted 8–0 to recommend it, with one member excused.[[0:13:00]] Resolution 26-89 would let the mayor move unspent money within a department, under limits the council sets.[[0:14:01]] It passed 6–3 on a roll call.[[0:43:19]] Members voted 9–0 to recommend it after amending it.[[2:08:47]] A county litigator said the change could make county attorneys witnesses and force the county to hire outside lawyers.[[2:14:20]] Members voted 9–0 to send the claims proposal to the full council without a recommendation.[[3:06:51]] The council vacancy proposal was deferred without objection.[[3:19:08]] The recommendations go to the full council, most likely on July 7th.[[3:52:01]]
meeting.next: A committee report will be prepared and sent to the full council. The chair agreed staff can write to the finance department about the claims proposal. The committee can write to the managing director about where claims should be filed. The chair said the council vacancy proposal could be worked on later and referred to the next council.
